groups.criterion_quote: the system of controls to manage waste control and disposal

source_evidence.quote: the system of controls to manage waste control and disposal

groups.reason: All three provisions address waste treatment and disposal, each providing a specific operational requirement that supports the same broad benchmark criterion. They do not represent independent cumulative requirements of the CP, nor are they alternatives; they are different expressions of the same waste control obligation.

rationale_summary: The three grounded norms all relate to waste control and disposal, each specifying a particular context (accredited property, establishment design, establishment condition). They jointly support the single CP criterion without establishing cumulative or alternative relationships.
